Target company: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD). AMD designs computing and graphics processors, including Ryzen, EPYC and Radeon products, serving PC, data-center, gaming and embedded markets.

Focal announcement: AMD Unveils Purpose-Built, FPGA-Based Accelerator for Ultra-Low Latency Electronic Trading.

Decision cutoff: 2023-09-27T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: AMD Unveils Purpose-Built, FPGA-Based Accelerator for Ultra-Low Latency Electronic Trading. Published date: 2023-09-27. URL: https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1158/amd-unveils-purpose-built-fpga-based-accelerator-for-ultra-low-latency-electronic-trading.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: — New AMD Alveo fintech accelerator card provides trading firms and brokerages with breakthrough trade execution performance at nanosecond speed and AI-enabled trading strategies — SANTA CLARA, Calif., Sept. 27, 2023 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) today announced the AMD Alveo™ UL3524 accelerator card , a new fintech accelerator designed for ultra-low latency electronic trading applications. “The Alveo UL3524 accelerator card is powered by the lowest latency FPGA transceiver from AMD—purpose-built to give our fintech customers an unprecedented competitive advantage in financial markets.” Hardware Flexibility and AI-Enabled Trading Strategies Featuring 64 ultra-low latency transceivers, 780K LUTs of FPGA fabric, and 1,680 DSP slices of compute, the Alveo UL3254 is built to accelerate custom trading algorithms in hardware, where traders can tailor their design to evolving strategies and market conditions. Enabling a Growing Ecosystem of Ultra-Low Latency Fintech Solutions The Alveo UL3524 and purpose-built FPGA technology are enabling strategic partners to build custom solutions and infrastructure for the fintech market.
